eSIM_IoT.label: eSIM IoT
eSIM_IoT.description: The interface between eIM and IPA as described in GSMA SGP.32.

State.label: State
State.description:
Status
					0  ready to receive eIM message
					1  not able to receive eIM message
					Note: In case value is >0 then writing to resource 2 shall not be possible

EID.label: EID
EID.description: EID of the eUICC that is target of the object

eIM_message.label: eIM message
eIM_message.description: The message from eIM to IPA. The message shall be in the ASN.1 DER format defined in SGP.32 Section 6.3.1

IPA_message.label: IPA message
IPA_message.description: The message from IPA to eIM. The message shall be in the ASN.1 DER format defined in GSMA SGP.32 section 6.3.1

Clear_IPA_message.label: Clear IPA message
Clear_IPA_message.description: In case Send or Confirmable Notifications is not used to deliver IPA messsage then execution of this resource will confirm delivery of the IPA message and clear the resource 3.
